title: Sourdough Discard Chocolate Brownie Cookies

ingredients: 1/2 Cup Unsalted Butter (8 tbsp), softened at room temperature
1 Cup Sourdough Discard, 100% hydration and unfed
Flaky Sea Salt (like Maldon) for topping (optional)
directions: In the bowl of a stand mixer using a paddle attachment, cream together the soft butter and sugars on medium speed until smooth. This can take 2–3 minutes. Make sure there are no lumps of butter.
Add in the sourdough discard and mix until completely smooth.
Use a spatula or wooden spoon to scrape the sides and bottom, making sure everything is combined.
Add in the egg and vanilla extract and mix just until combined. Do not over-mix.
In a separate medium bowl combine the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt. Mix with a fork or whisk to combine.
Add the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients, adding only a little bit at a time. Mix just until incorporated.
Cover with plastic wrap and chill in the fridge for 2–3 hours up to overnight.
Remove from fridge and allow the dough to come to room temperature for about 10 minutes.

Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Using a 2-tablespoon cookie scoop, form the dough balls. Roll into balls and place on the prepared baking sheets at least 3 inches apart.
Bake for 13–14 minutes then give them a little sprinkle of flaky sea salt.
If the cookies did not spread out and flatten, gently hit the bottom of the pan on the counter to help them set.
Transfer to a wire rack and allow to cool.

notes: For best results, this dough is chilled before baking. Allow at least 2–3 hours up to overnight if you can.
This dough bakes better chilled for at least 2–3 hours. If you don't have time, make into balls and freeze for 20–30 minutes.
